scope: Philippines-wide discovery source for inland-fisheries statistics; not a waterbody inventory

source.title: Inland Municipal Fisheries: Volume of Production by Geolocation, Species, Year and Quarter
source.dataDefinition: Total weight in metric tonnes of species caught in inland bodies of water during the reference quarter.
source.metadataTerms: The PSA metadata page states that OpenSTAT content is public domain unless otherwise stated; the table page marks copyright No. Preserve source attribution and re-check table-specific notices before redistribution.

metadataPageFindings.sourceStatus: Metadata reports latest available year 2025; the official API returns numeric 2025 totals and 2026 Q1 and preliminary Q2 values, while 2026 Q3/Q4 cells are marked .. (Data not available).

liveTableFindings.preliminaryNote: The interactive table notes that Q2 2026 values are preliminary.
liveTableFindings.conflict: The official PXWeb schema identifies 2026 as a selectable year and the reproducible national query returns Q1 and Q2 values. directApiAttempt.result: The preliminary request used an incorrect endpoint path and returned HTTP 403. The canonical PXWeb endpoint below responds successfully; the earlier 403 was not an access restriction.

accessReview.crossCoverage: PSA reports QIFS coverage of 80 provinces. The crosswalk identifies 82 current province codes, five separately reported cities, and one unresolved duplicate legacy Sulu code. Preliminary 2026 Q2 has 78 numeric province totals and four . (Category not applicable) province totals. The public release does not provide the exact 80-code QIFS roster, so do not infer which codes were surveyed from the aggregate statement.

successfulApiExport.geographyScopeNote: The 107 geographies include one national total, 18 regions, 82 current provinces, five separately mapped cities, and one unresolved legacy Sulu code (1906600000); current Sulu (0906600000) remains a separate matched province.
successfulApiExport.zeroNotation: 0.00 denotes volume of production is less than two decimal points but not zero.

accessReview.nextAction: Continue locality-resolved source research for named Luzon rivers, lakes, reservoirs, wetlands and coastal waters, using QIFS only to prioritize searches. Separately request PSA confirmation of the 80-province QIFS roster and the duplicate legacy Sulu code treatment. Preserve . (Category not applicable), .. (Data not available), 0.00, and preliminary Q2 values as distinct source states; do not project provincial totals into waterbody or species claims.

decision.use: Use QIFS as a fast province/region-level candidate and research-prioritization layer across Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao, then validate candidates against locality-resolved surveys or specimen records for each named waterbody.
decision.waterbodyResolution: No river, lake, reservoir, wetland, marsh, sample station, or household identity is exposed in the reviewed metadata; provincial production is not assignable to a particular waterbody.

limitations: The table reports production categories and catches, not a complete fish inventory, occurrence event database, or exhaustive regional species checklist.
Provincial and regional aggregation cannot identify the river, lake, reservoir, wetland, sampling date, or exact catch location.
The live-table and metadata latest-year statements conflict and must be reconciled before data are imported.
PSA 2026 clearance covers 80 provinces for QIFS; exact coverage varies by survey year and requires explicit coverage accounting.
Common production labels may be broader than species rank; do not assign scientific names from common names alone.
Production quantity is not abundance, current presence in a specific waterbody, catchability, safety, legal access, or diet evidence.

The official table footnote defines . as Category not applicable and .. as Data not available; both must remain distinct from numeric zero. 0.00 is explicitly a nonzero production value below the displayed two-decimal precision.

PSA reports survey coverage of 80 provinces, while the dimension crosswalk contains 82 current province codes and four preliminary 2026 Q2 province totals marked Category not applicable. The exact covered-province roster is not exposed in the reviewed release.
nextAction: Crosswalk all 107 geography codes to the current administrative registry and the 80-province QIFS coverage statement, resolving city units and the two Sulu-coded entries. Use the existing national fetch script for selected year batches at or below the 100,000-cell cap, preserve every .. unavailable marker and 0.00 note, then rank local river, lake, reservoir, wetland and coastal source searches without assigning provincial production to a waterbody.
